name: Kais Saied
bio: Former constitutional law professor. Seized full power July 25 2021. Controls all branches.
risk: Isolation from technocratic class; health rumors unconfirmed.

name: Tunisian Armed Forces
bio: Professional military, historically apolitical. Loyalty contingent on salary payments.
risk: Pay arrears risk loyalty drift if reserves collapse.

name: National Security Forces
bio: Ministry of Interior apparatus. Key tool of political repression.
risk: Overstretch if simultaneous multi-city protests erupt.

name: Rached Ghannouchi
bio: Co-founder of Ennahdha. Sentenced to 22 years. Martyr symbol for opposition.
risk: Deteriorating health in detention could trigger protests.

name: Noureddine Taboubi
bio: Controls largest trade union (750,000 members). General strike threat.
risk: Key swing actor — could tip balance against regime if economic pressure mounts.

name: Ahmed Nejib Chebbi
bio: Veteran politician, leads exile opposition coalition from Tunis/Brussels.

name: IMF Mission
bio: Delayed USD 1.9B loan tranche. Conditions include fuel subsidy reform.
risk: Continued delay accelerates BCT reserve depletion.

name: Judiciary
bio: Purged and recomposed by Saied since 2022. Now fully subordinate.
risk: Loss of legitimacy accelerates elite defection.
